faq.question: What is the Social Media Marketing & Growth course?
faq.answer: The Social Media Marketing & Growth course is a practical 6-week, 48-hour certification program focused on organic brand building, content planning, community management, creator collaborations, and performance analytics across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. It teaches you how to grow brand trust and measurable business impact without relying on paid advertising.

faq.question: Is the course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, the course is structured from foundational concepts up to intermediate execution. It begins with audience research, brand positioning, and platform fundamentals before advancing to 30-day editorial calendars, Reels briefing, community crisis management, and analytics reporting. No prior marketing or graphic design background is required.

faq.question: What is the course duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course duration is 6 Weeks comprising 48 guided learning hours across 6 comprehensive modules. The transparent course fee is ₹6,900 plus applicable taxes under our Truth in Pricing policy, with zero hidden charges or fake countdown discounts.

faq.question: Does it cover Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn?
faq.answer: Yes, the curriculum provides dedicated operational and strategic coverage of Instagram (professional accounts, Reels, carousels, Insights), Facebook (Business Pages, Meta Business Suite management), and LinkedIn (Company Pages, thought-leadership carousels, B2B audience analytics).

faq.question: Will I learn Reels and short-form content strategy?
faq.answer: Yes, you will master the strategic planning, hook structuring, scriptwriting, visual scene direction, and audio trend research for Instagram Reels and short-form video. Note that this covers creative briefing and mobile content planning; complex cinema-grade video editing is outside the course scope.

faq.question: Does the course teach Canva and ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Yes, you will use Canva hands-on to create brand-consistent social media templates, story layouts, and educational carousels. You will also learn how to leverage ChatGPT as a creative assistant for audience brainstorming, hook ideation, caption variations, and community response drafting under human editorial supervision.

faq.question: Will I learn community management?
faq.answer: Yes, community management is a core pillar of the course. Module 04 is dedicated to comment moderation, direct-message management, customer service response standards, handling negative feedback, social listening, user-generated content permissions, and crisis escalation protocols.

faq.question: Does the course include influencer marketing?
faq.answer: Yes, Module 05 teaches influencer and creator collaboration fundamentals, including finding relevant niche creators, evaluating engagement authenticity, drafting professional collaboration briefs, managing gifting/barter workflows, and complying with the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) disclosure guidelines.

faq.question: Are practical projects included?
faq.answer: Yes, you will complete 4 portfolio-ready deliverables: (1) a 30-Day Multi-Platform Content Calendar, (2) a 12-Asset Content Production Portfolio (Reels, carousels, static posts, LinkedIn articles), (3) a Brand Community Management Playbook, and (4) an Organic Growth Dashboard in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Will I learn organic growth analytics?
faq.answer: Yes, Module 06 covers native platform analytics across Meta Business Suite, Instagram Insights, and LinkedIn Analytics. You will learn to evaluate reach, impressions, engagement rates, save/share velocity, follower quality, and link clicks, compiling them into clear, client-ready monthly growth dashboards.

faq.question: Does the course include Facebook and Instagram paid Ads?
faq.answer: No, this course is strictly dedicated to organic social media strategy, content planning, and community development. Detailed paid advertising, Meta Ads Manager, Advantage+ campaigns, and conversion tracking are comprehensively taught in Course 32: Meta Ads & Lead Generation Specialist.

faq.question: What career opportunities are available after completing the course?
faq.answer: Graduates are prepared for practical roles such as Social Media Executive, Organic Social Media Specialist, Community Management Executive, Content Planning Coordinator, Influencer Marketing Coordinator, or Social Media Reporting Assistant, as well as providing freelance social media management services to businesses.
